about:
I finished my M.S. in NLP at UC Santa Cruz in December 2025, so I know what's going on inside the models most AI products are built on. Most recently I was a founding engineer at Causality, formerly Levangie Laboratories, one of two engineers building AI that learns how experts judge, decide and act.

I like figuring out what people actually need and then building it myself.

Always happy to talk with people building thoughtful AI products, or about surfing.
location: Santa Cruz, CA. Open to relocating, and happy to work in person in SF, the Peninsula, or San Jose.
lookingFor: Product engineer and builder roles on AI products, in the Bay Area or fully remote in the US.
availability: Available now. His founding engineer contract at Causality, formerly Levangie Laboratories, ended in September 2026.
contractEnd: He was brought on to take Causality's platform and agents to a defined milestone, and the contract wrapped up in September 2026 once that work was delivered.
experienceSummary: About two and a half years of professional engineering, starting at Boardal in April 2024, plus an M.S. in NLP. He's targeting junior to mid-level roles and is open to some senior roles where the scope fits.
strongestProject: No RAGrets, his capstone partnership with CarbonBridge. He led the build of a tool that pulls findings out of scientific papers, links them in a knowledge graph, and traces every answer back to its source.
now: He's packaging the dev tools that have helped him into open source projects and running small experiments like MCP tests and agent benchmarks. Next he's rebuilding the CarbonBridge tool as a public demo where you can feed in your own papers. After that comes a long-term surf agent project he plans to build in public.
